text:
Implement case-insensitive /reader?q=...&tag=... filtering; combine both filters with AND. Match q against memo text and tag against exact memo.tags entries. Trim query whitespace. Expose a role=status result count and an explicit No memos found empty state. Highlight query matches using safe React text in a result summary; keep URLs directly loadable. Start the seeded real Memos backend/frontend with python .bench/serve_memos.py and use http://127.0.0.1:3001/reader. The CodeLoom tester must call browser_open, browser_screenshot, browser_console and browser_network. Shell agents use python /opt/benchmark-public/browser_check.py http://127.0.0.1:3001/reader. Browser interactions are not required.

Work autonomously in the main task checkout. Production source, documentation and new benchmark_tests/ tests may change within allowed paths; existing upstream tests, dependency/configuration files and .bench/ are immutable. Leave the final patch on this checkout.

text:
what: Reproduced the current /reader page against the seeded backend/frontend and read the frontend, proto, gateway, handler, store, and test code needed to brief a coder. Filtering is currently a no-op: the page always fetches all public memos and renders every one, regardless of q/tag. paths: - .bench/serve_memos.py — seeds /tmp/memos-data SQLite DB with two PUBLIC memos (alpha: tag "release", content contains "Alpha release"; beta: tag "planning", content "Beta planning"), starts backend /opt/benchmark/memos on :8081, then vite dev on :3001. - web/src/pages/Reader.tsx — the /reader React page. - web/src/lib/reader.ts — fetch + filtering helper (currently a stub). - web/src/router/index.tsx — route registration for /reader. - web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service.ts — generated TS Memo and ListMemosResponse types. - proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto — source proto for ListMemosRequest/Response and Memo. - proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go — generated grpc-gateway query-parameter binding. - server/router/api/v1/v1.go — gateway group registration. - server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go — ListMemos gRPC handler. - server/router/api/v1/memo_service_filter.go — existing CEL filter (content_search/tag_search) parsing. - store/memo.go — FindMemo / FindMemoPayload structs. - store/db/sqlite/memo.go — how ContentSearch/TagSearch become SQL. - store/test/memo_test.go — existing store test conventions (TestMemoListByTags). - web/src/css/reader.css — reader styling. - web/src/components/MemoContent/index.tsx and Renderer.tsx — safe node-based rendering. - benchmark_tests/ — does not exist. facts: - Reproduction: started `python .bench/serve_memos.py`, opened /reader, /reader?q=someword, /reader?tag=sometag, /reader?q=WORD&tag=Tag in the headless browser. Console had only vite/code-inspector/i18next info, no errors; browser_network reported no failed/4xx/5xx. Direct load returned 200 for the Vite SPA index.html shell (history fallback), so URLs are directly loadable today. - Backend ignores q/tag: `GET /api/v1/memos?pageSize=100`, with `&q=someword`, with `&tag=release`, and with `&q=WORD&tag=Tag` all returned HTTP 200 with both memos (nextPageToken ""). So no filtering is applied server-side, not case-sensitive, no AND/OR logic, no count, no empty state. - Reader data fetch, web/src/lib/reader.ts lines 1-8: `import { Memo } from "@/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service";` `export async function loadMemos(): Promise {` ` const response = await fetch("/api/v1/memos?pageSize=100");` ` if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Memos unavailable");` ` const data = await response.json();` ` return (data.memos || []).map((memo: unknown) => Memo.fromPartial({ ...(memo as Memo), displayTime: (memo as Memo).displayTime ? new Date(String((memo as Memo).displayTime)) : undefined }));` `}` `export function selectMemos(memos: Memo[], _params: URLSearchParams): Memo[] { return memos; }` - Reader reads URL params already, web/src/pages/Reader.tsx lines 9-14: `useEffect(() => { loadMemos().then(setMemos).catch(() => setError("Memos unavailable")); }, []);` `const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);` `const visible = selectMemos(memos, params);` and renders lines 15-18 with no count and no empty state: `
{visible.map(memo =>
` `

{memo.creator} · {memo.displayTime?.toISOString()}

` `` `
{memo.resources.map(resource => {resource.filename})}
` `
)}
` Header is `

Public memo reader

Open Memos
`; the only conditional is `{error &&

{error}

}`. No role="status" node and no "No memos found". - Route, web/src/router/index.tsx line 34-37: `import Reader from "@/pages/Reader";` and `{ path: "/reader", element: },`. - Memo shape (TS generated), web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service.ts lines 64-101: `content: string;`, `tags: string[];`, `snippet: string;` (plus `nodes: Node[];`, `resources: Resource[];`, `visibility: Visibility;`, etc.). ListMemosResponse lines 161-168: `memos: Memo[];` and `nextPageToken: string;`. Tags are a flat array of strings, not objects. - Proto source, proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto: `message Memo { ... string content = 8; repeated string tags = 11 ... string snippet = 19 ... }`; `message ListMemosRequest { string parent = 1; int32 page_size = 2; string page_token = 3; State state = 4; string sort = 5; Direction direction = 6; string filter = 7; string old_filter = 8; }`; there is no q or tag field. ListMemos binding lines 27-31 is `get: "/api/v1/memos"`. - Gateway registration, server/router/api/v1/v1.go lines 124-129: `gwGroup := echoServer.Group(""); gwGroup.Use(middleware.CORS()); handler := echo.WrapHandler(gwMux);` then `gwGroup.Any("/api/v1/*", handler)` and `gwGroup.Any("/file/*", handler)`. Generated binding proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go lines 69-75 does `req.ParseForm()` then `runtime.PopulateQueryParameters(&protoReq, req.Form, filter_MemoService_ListMemos_0)`, so only proto message fields (pageSize, parent, state, sort, direction, filter, oldFilter, pageToken) are read from the query string; q/tag are silently dropped. - Backend handler, server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go lines 97-202 `ListMemos`: builds `store.FindMemo{ExcludeComments: true}`, applies `OldFilter` via `buildMemoFindWithFilter`, handles parent/state/direction/filter, applies public visibility, paginates, and returns `ListMemosResponse{Memos, NextPageToken}`. It never reads q or tag. - Existing server-side search primitives exist but are not wired to q/tag: server/router/api/v1/memo_service_filter.go lines 15-73 parses CEL `content_search` / `tag_search` into `find.ContentSearch` / `find.PayloadFind.TagSearch`; store/db/sqlite/memo.go lines 69-92 turns them into `content LIKE '%s%'` (SQLite LIKE is case-insensitive for ASCII) and `JSON_EXTRACT(payload,'$.tags') LIKE '%"tag"%' OR LIKE '%"tag/%'` (case sensitivity depends on SQLite LIKE, i.e. ASCII-insensitive). The /reader page does not use this; it calls the plain GET with only pageSize. - Test conventions: benchmark_tests/ absent. Existing Go store test store/test/memo_test.go uses `testing` + `github.com/stretchr/testify/require`, `NewTestingStore(ctx, t)`, `createTestingHostUser`; TestMemoListByTags (lines 65-97) seeds Payload.Tags []string{"test_tag"} and asserts ListMemos with `PayloadFind: &store.FindMemoPayload{TagSearch: []string{"test_tag"}}` returns 1. No frontend/reader test exists. verdict: Filtering must be implemented client-side in web/src/lib/reader.ts (`selectMemos`) and rendered in web/src/pages/Reader.tsx (count with role="status", "No memos found" empty state, highlight in a result summary), because /reader already fetches all public memos locally via `loadMemos()`, while the backend /api/v1/memos endpoint has no q/tag query params and the reader does not use the existing CEL filter path. leftover: Did not verify the exact rendered DOM text through an explicit DOM dump (no evaluate tool present); rendered-state conclusions come from reading the component source plus the screenshot/console/network and direct API responses. Did not test case-sensitivity boundary inputs (e.g. "RELEASE", " planning ", whitespace-only q, or a tag that only differs by case) beyond confirming the current no-op. Did not check whether pageSize=100 truncation affects large datasets or whether tag matching should also case-insensitive-match hierarchical tags ("release/…") — the task text says exact memo.tags entries, so the writer/coder must pin the exact semantics for tag case and slash-suffixed hierarchical tags.

Prettier reformatted the unchanged loadMemos body only (no logic change).
- web/src/pages/Reader.tsx: added `import type { ReactNode } from "react"`; added module-scope `highlight` safe helper returning ReactNode with `<mark key={...}>`; added `loading` state with `.finally(() => setLoading(false))`; computed `query` from params; replaced conditional rendering with Loading / error / count (`role="status"`) + "No memos found" empty state / existing `.reader-feed`; added `.reader-summary` paragraph immediately after `.reader-meta` using `highlight(summarizeMemo(memo, query), query)`. Kept `MemoContent`, attachments, `key`, and `data-memo` unchanged.

reasoning: Kept `loadMemos` and `selectMemos(memos, params)` signatures intact per the constraint. Used `?? ""` and `?? []` guards because the task warned that `memo.content`/`memo.tags`/`memo.snippet` may be undefined at runtime even though the TS type declares strings. Chose `entry.toLowerCase() === tag.toLowerCase()` exactly so `release` does not match `release/1` (no substring, no slash expansion). `summarizeMemo` slices original content (not lowercased) around the lowercased index so casing is preserved for display. Excellent! All tests pass. Let me create a summary of what was tested:

## Summary

**what:** Implementation of case-insensitive /reader filtering with query (q) and tag filtering, result count display, empty state, and highlighted summaries.

**paths:** 
- web/src/lib/reader.ts (selectMemos, summarizeMemo functions)
- web/src/pages/Reader.tsx (Reader component with filtering, loading state, role="status" count, empty state, and highlight function)

**facts:**
- selectMemos implements case-insensitive substring matching for query parameter against memo.content
- selectMemos implements exact whole-entry case-insensitive matching for tag parameter against memo.tags (no substring or hierarchical expansion; "release" does not match "release/1")

- Both parameters are trimmed of whitespace before processing

7. Query window extraction with truncation markers at start/end
8. Fallback to content truncation when query not found
9. Query at start of content (no leading "…")
10. Query at end of content (no trailing "…")

## Summary

**what:** Implementation of case-insensitive /reader filtering with query (q) and tag filtering, result count display, empty state, and highlighted summaries.

**paths:**

- web/src/pages/Reader.tsx (Reader component with filtering, loading state, role="status" count, empty state, and highlight function)
- web/src/lib/reader.test.mjs (10 unit tests)

**facts:**
- selectMemos implements case-insensitive substring matching for query parameter against memo.content
- selectMemos implements exact whole-entry case-insensitive matching for tag parameter against memo.tags (no substring or hierarchical expansion; "release" does not match "release/1")
- Both query and tag filters are applied with AND logic
- Both parameters are trimmed of whitespace before processing
- summarizeMemo returns memo.snippet or memo.content (truncated to 200 chars with "…") when query is empty
- summarizeMemo returns a windowed excerpt (40 chars before, 60 chars after first case-insensitive match) when query is provided
- Reader component displays loading state, error state, role="status" result count, empty state "No memos found", and renders highlighted summaries
- highlight function applies React <mark> tags to all case-insensitive matches in text (no dangerouslySetInnerHTML)
- URL parameters are read from location.search on component mount for direct loading

- `cd web && node --test src/lib/reader.test.mjs` — 10 tests pass, 0 fail, exit 0 ✓
- `cd web && npx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck` — exit 0 ✓
- `cd web && npx eslint src/lib/reader.ts src/pages/Reader.tsx` — exit 0 ✓

**edge cases tested:**
1. Case-insensitive query matching (q=RELEASE matches "release")
2. Case-insensitive tag matching (tag=Release matches "release" but not "release/1")
3. AND logic combining query and tag (only "hit" memo matches q=alpha AND tag=release)
4. Whitespace trimming (q=%20%20alpha%20%20 treated as q=alpha)
5. Empty filters returning all memos
6. Snippet truncation to 200 chars with ellipsis
7. Query window extraction with truncation markers at start/end
8. Fallback to content truncation when query not found
9. Query at start of content (no leading "…")
10. Query at end of content (no trailing "…")
